en.headline: Theme park performer Bernice Yuen crowned Miss Hong Kong 2026
en.dek: The 26-year-old Baptist University graduate won Sunday night’s final at TVB City, with Ada Tang and Scarlett Li named first and second runners-up.
body: Theme park performer Bernice Yuen Sze-hang was crowned Miss Hong Kong 2026 on Sunday night at TVB City in Tseung Kwan O, after 12 contestants competed in the broadcaster’s annual pageant.

Yuen, 26, is a Hong Kong Baptist University communication graduate who has worked as a theme park performer and in theatre, commercials, hosting and modelling. After the result was announced she said she had not realised the final was ending until her name was called, and described herself as shocked and happy.

Ada Tang Hong-man was named first runner-up. Scarlett Li Chak-yan was second runner-up and Miss Photogenic. Chorie Li Ching-ching received the Miss Friendship title. The final was staged under the slogan Dare To Be Perfect.

zh.headline: 主題樂園演員袁絲珩奪2026香港小姐冠軍
zh.dek: 26歲浸大傳理畢業生周日晚於將軍澳電視城勝出港姐決賽，鄧匡閵及李澤欣分獲亞軍及季軍。
body: 主題樂園演員袁絲珩周日晚於將軍澳電視廣播城舉行的《2026香港小姐競選》決賽勝出，12名佳麗角逐冠、亞、季軍及其他獎項。
現年26歲的袁絲珩畢業於香港浸會大學傳理系，曾擔任主題樂園演員，亦有舞臺劇、廣告、司儀及模特兒工作。頒獎後她表示，決賽進行兩、三小時，直至宣布名次才意識到賽事完結，聽到自己名字時既驚訝亦開心。
亞軍為鄧匡閵，季軍兼最上鏡小姐為李澤欣，友誼小姐由李澄晴獲得。本屆決賽口號為「敢·至完美」。
